text:
Samir Patel: Heads up — MicroBurst Labs asked for a one-off pilot pricing concession. They want a 3‑month pilot with heavy dev traffic. Sales is proposing a pilot credit rather than changing list prices. Need deal desk + finance ok.

Elaine Morris: Can you drop the numbers and why we should approve?

Samir Patel: Quick summary: customer is a strategic platform partner, potential $2M ARR if pilot converts. Ask = 60% credit for first 3 months, cap at $25k. They want Net45 but sales prefers Net30.

Roger Kim: Adding context from Sales Ops — account has 90 days of activity; expected peak tokens ~25M/month during pilot. If we give 60% off token charges that's ~ $20k/mo which fits the $25k cap w/ expected usage curve.

Maya Chen: Technical note — traffic will have bursts; recommend adding auto-throttle to avoid huge overages. Also propose prefix cache enabled + dedicated small instance for pilot to meet latency SLOs.

Elaine Morris: From finance perspective a couple questions: 1) is this a credit against invoices or a prepaid rebate? 2) who owns the credit if they churn early? 3) approval thresholds — $25k one-off needs manager signoff but >20k requires VP review per policy.

Samir Patel: Proposal: issue credit as a post-bill rebate applied monthly for the pilot term. If they churn, credit remains applied to billed usage (no clawback). We can cap at $25k. Sales ok with Net30.

Lina Torres: Legal: we need an addendum to the MSA with pilot terms, explicit cap, and success metrics. Also add a clause: pilot credits expire if not invoiced within 6 months. Can draft a short SOW.

Elaine Morris: Okay. Budget note: I can approve up to $20k. Anything between $20k-$50k needs VP finance signoff. Who is the VP on this?

Samir Patel: VP is Marco Rivera — added him to the thread. @Marco Rivera — can you weigh in?

Marco Rivera: (joined) I reviewed the pipeline and this one warrants an exception. I approve up to $25k one-time pilot credit, conditional on: 1) SOW + addendum signed; 2) Net30 payment; 3) usage cap and auto-throttle in place.

billing-bot: Note: created exception ticket EXC-2026-117 in billing system for tracking.

Roger Kim: Thanks Marco. Action items: Samir to send customer SOW draft, Lina to produce addendum, Elaine to raise the accounting ticket for rebate accounting. Roger will add the cap to billing settings.

Samir Patel: Will do — sending draft SOW to Lina now. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Elaine Morris: Finance sign-off recorded. I'll mark as approved in Deal Desk queue and set GL treatment.

Maya Chen: I'll add the throttle config and test in staging next week.

Lina Torres: Drafting addendum now. Will ping when ready for review.

Samir Patel: Closing loop — customer informed, they accepted pilot terms verbally. We'll only send formal docs after Legal/Finance finish.

billing-bot: EXC-2026-117 status changed to APPROVED by Marco Rivera.
